description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Edit' feature for articles, including request handling, validation, and database operations related to editing or updating an article.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Namespace encapsulating the article editing feature, including command, model, validator, and handler classes.

classes.name: CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the article model in the command is not null.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Handles the process of editing an article, including fetching, updating, and saving to the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method to process the article edit command, updating the article's details and tags in the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article based on the provided tag list.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from the article based on the provided tag list.
